baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا
baseline_models.mechanism: Overmastering preoccupation breaks two adjacent forms of life-maintaining continuity: the feeder loses the fed from attention, and the bearer releases what was held within. Repeated كُلّ makes the rupture exhaustive rather than anecdotal.

activation_trace.role: Forgetting or leaving something under a stronger preoccupation supplies the attentional severance.
Suckling from breast or udder supplies the life-maintaining caregiver-recipient bond that is abandoned.
Comprehensive enclosure and totality supply exhaustive scope to both caregiver and bearer.
Casting off pregnancy in birth supplies the bodily release that parallels attentional release.
The hidden pregnancy or fruit-load supplies contained life whose continuity is interrupted.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives two separate examples of maternal panic.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a systematic unbinding of prenatal containment and postnatal care across every bearer and feeder.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَتَرَى ٱلنَّاسَ سُكَارَى وَمَا هُم بِسُكَارَى وَلَكِنَّ عَذَابَ ٱللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Vision reports an intoxication-like public phenotype; explicit negation blocks intoxication as its cause; the final clause replaces that diagnosis with punishment whose force overwhelms ordinary coordination.

activation_trace.role: Eye and insight perception supply both the witnessed event and the witnessed human symptom.
Loss of sobriety through drink or an analogous overpowering state supplies the appearance that is asserted and then causally denied.
Painful punishment supplies the verse's replacement cause for the intoxication-like condition.
Concentrated force and hardness supply the intensity capable of disorganizing bodies without wine.

changed_reading.before: The crowd is literally drunk or merely compared loosely to drunk people.
changed_reading.after: The crowd is visibly sober-yet-intoxicated: the symptom is accurate, but the verse corrects its causal diagnosis.

baseline_models.mechanism: The opening day functions not only as a date but as the occurrence itself in its severity; the two acts of seeing make the event occupy the whole perceptual field.

activation_trace.role: A day used for a descended calamity and its severity turns the timestamp into an event-pressure.
Repeated seeing supplies the event's perceptual saturation, first as occurrence and then as altered humanity.
Hard force supplies the severity by which the day is experienced rather than merely dated.

changed_reading.before: يَوْمَ simply locates the described reactions on a future date.
changed_reading.after: The day is the descending catastrophic occurrence whose pressure reorganizes attention, reproduction, and appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first names the quake, then supplies an ordinary life sequence: settling in womb, remaining to an appointed term, emerging as a child, and reaching maturity; it also shows dead earth shaking into life. The focus event runs against that continuity by forcing hidden life outward and severing the care needed after emergence.

activation_trace.role: Suckling supplies the post-emergence nourishment whose continuity fails.
Birth-like release supplies the focus sequence's abrupt outward movement.
Hidden pregnancy supplies the developmental content released before its ordinary continuity can matter.
Oscillation and violent shaking supply the immediate physical activator of the reversal.
Fixity and settlement supply the normal holding phase that the focus disrupts.
The female womb supplies the explicit container for the normal developmental sequence.
A fixed temporal limit supplies orderly completion in contrast to catastrophic release.
Passage to the outside supplies normal emergence after the appointed holding period.
The newborn child supplies the stage that ordinarily receives continuing care.
Arrival at a goal supplies maturation as the sequence's intended continuation.
Earth's shaking into vegetal life supplies a constructive counterpart to the focus quake's destructive shaking.

structural_cues: 22:1 places the earthquake immediately before the focus reactions.
22:5 orders womb-settlement -> appointed term -> child-emergence -> maturity, then pairs shaking earth with renewed life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordinary developmental order and two kinds of shaking. I infer a reversal arrow from ordered containment and growth to forced release and failed care. A live alternative is that the focus gives independent fear reactions without formally reversing 22:5.

changed_reading.before: The nursing and pregnancy images are vivid but independent symptoms of terror.
changed_reading.after: They form a counter-developmental montage: the event undoes the sequence from gestational holding through emergence to sustaining care.

context_deltas.mechanism: Womb, carried load, and sky become nested holding systems. The surah describes pregnancy settled in its container and the sky actively held from falling, while another figure falls from the sky and is hurled away. Against that field, every bearer putting down its load marks a general transition from suspension to release.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing down into a lower or fixed place supplies the spatial release.
An inwardly carried pregnancy or fruit-load supplies the local held system.
Settlement and stability supply the normal persistence of what is held.
Holding and restraining the sky supply the cosmic-scale containment analogue.
Falling and coming to rest supply the outcome actively prevented in ordinary cosmic order.
A noisy, disordered fall supplies the contrasting image of containment already lost.
Descent into an abyss supplies the uncontrolled trajectory after release.

structural_cues: 22:31 images a body falling from the sky and being driven into a distant place.
22:65 images the sky as continuously held back from falling except by permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several held containers and explicit falling. I infer that the focus birth image participates in this hold/release architecture. A live alternative is that تضع remains only a physiological consequence of fright, with no cosmic containment analogy.

changed_reading.before: Every pregnant bearer gives birth from terror.
changed_reading.after: The birth image is also a local instance of the event's larger suspension-ending logic: what is normally held can no longer remain held.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly separates visible surfaces from inward diagnosis: trial flips a person onto his face, eyes may remain functional while hearts go blind, and inward refusal becomes recognizable on faces. The focus performs the same discipline in miniature by preserving the visual report 'intoxicated' while rejecting intoxication as the reality behind it.

activation_trace.role: Sensory and insightful seeing supply the observation whose interpretation must be corrected.
Lost sobriety supplies a convincing bodily appearance but an explicitly rejected literal cause.
Turning a thing from its face supplies ordeal translated into bodily reversal.
The face supplies the visible surface on which inward instability is enacted.
Reason as a restraint on ignorance supplies the capacity needed to move from symptom to cause.
Blindness of heart or insight supplies the failure that can coexist with physically seeing eyes.
Ocular sight supplies the intact surface faculty that does not guarantee correct understanding.
Recognition by a visible trace supplies the legibility of an inward state without equating trace and cause.
Faces again supply the bodily display from which an inner condition is read.

structural_cues: 22:11 maps instability of allegiance onto a face-first bodily reversal.
22:46 explicitly distinguishes seeing eyes from blind hearts.
22:72 makes an inward refusal recognizable in faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated surface/interior distinctions. I infer that the focus negation is an epistemic correction from accurate appearance to accurate cause. A live alternative is that the construction serves only rhetorical intensification of fear.

changed_reading.before: The drunken appearance is a conventional simile for panic.
changed_reading.after: The appearance becomes a compact test of reading: perception catches the symptom, while insight must reject the obvious cause and locate the hidden force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus begins with interrupted feeding, passes through an intoxication image whose drink-cause is denied, and ends by naming punishment. Later punishment is rendered as hot fluid poured over bodies, interiors melted, and torment tasted. These cues align the focus images as an inversion of intake: nourishment and ordinary drink give way to forced, destructive ingestion.

activation_trace.role: Milk taken from breast or udder supplies the life-giving intake that is interrupted.
Drink-like loss of sobriety supplies an intake effect while the verse denies ordinary drinking as its cause.
Painful punishment supplies the destructive force that replaces nourishment and wine.
Pouring liquid supplies the imposed direction of the punitive intake circuit.
Scalding water supplies an anti-nourishing liquid.
Melting by heat supplies the liquid's destructive action on the body.
The body's interior supplies the destination where ordinary nourishment would sustain rather than destroy.
Tasting as undergoing and experiencing supplies forced experiential ingestion.
The repeated punishment root closes the context's pouring, melting, and tasting sequence.

structural_cues: 22:19-20 moves hot liquid from above the head into the body's interior.
22:22 commands the occupants to taste the punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interrupted nursing, denied intoxication, poured hot liquid, melted interiors, and tasting. I infer an anti-nourishment circuit linking them. A live alternative is that nursing and drunkenness are independent panic images and the later ingestive punishment is only thematic recurrence.

changed_reading.before: The caregiver and drunken crowd are unrelated examples before punishment is named.
changed_reading.after: They anticipate punishment as an inversion of intake: sustaining milk is abandoned, ordinary intoxicant is absent, and destructive experience enters in its place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah destabilizes ordinary duration by making one day comparable to a thousand counted years, then calls the suddenly arriving punishment a barren day. Beside the focus's discharged pregnancies and abandoned nurslings, barrenness turns the day from a date into a temporal regime that cuts off futurity.

activation_trace.role: A day as a severe descended occurrence supplies more than calendar location.
Pregnancy and fruit-bearing supply embodied futurity placed under the event's pressure.
Suckling supplies the future's dependence on continuing care after birth.
A day as flexible duration supplies temporal scale beyond ordinary human counting.
The aggregation of a thousand supplies the expanded comparison against one day.
Counting supplies the human temporal measure that the comparison exceeds.
The punishment day again functions as a severe occurrence rather than a neutral interval.
Sudden arrival supplies the absence of developmental or temporal preparation.
Barrenness in womb and offspring supplies the reproductive image transferred onto the day.

structural_cues: 22:47 contrasts one divine day with a thousand years of human counting.
22:55 joins sudden arrival, punishment, day, and barrenness in one phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elastic duration and an explicitly barren punishment-day. I map that reproductive epithet back onto the focus pregnancies and nurslings and infer cancelled futurity. A live alternative is that barren means only fruitless or unrelieved, with the obstetric echo incidental.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes what happens at a terrible future time.
changed_reading.after: Its day has an anti-future quality: duration loses ordinary scale while birth and care cease to carry life forward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عذاب denotes punishment in the syntax, not literal weaning. It remains anchored because the same focus-root inventory includes withholding or weaning, the verse opens with abandoned suckling, and 22:22 makes punishment something tasted. Render it only as a lexical-mechanistic echo, never as a replacement gloss for عذاب.

activation_trace.role: Literal suckling supplies the nourishment relation from which the infant is severed.
Withholding, prevention, and weaning supply an exploratory deprivation image inside the punishment root.
Pain and punishment preserve the controlling literal sense and contain the exploratory branch.
Tasting as undergoing an experience makes the deprivation echo part of an ingestive punishment scene.
The context's explicit punishment keeps the tasting scene causally tied to the focus conclusion.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an external force that happens to make a nurse forget.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical echo, punishment resembles catastrophic forced weaning: sustaining attachment and intake are withdrawn.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ conventionally foregrounds pregnant animate beings. It remains anchored because the focus branch for حمل explicitly joins womb-pregnancy with a tree's fruit, while 22:5 pairs human gestation with earth bringing forth every kind. Render it as an ecological resonance that enlarges the image, not as a denial of the obstetric sense.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive totality supplies pressure toward every bearer rather than one exemplary pregnancy.
The branch's shared image of womb-pregnancy and tree-fruit supplies the cross-domain bearer.
Casting out a pregnancy supplies the literal release from which the ecological resonance extends.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies a nonhuman life-bearing parallel.
Kinds or species supply the plurality of vegetal yields brought forth.

changed_reading.after: Without displacing pregnancy, the phrase resonates with every fruit- or offspring-bearing life system relinquishing what it carries.

strongest_changes: The paired maternal images became one mechanism of relational and developmental unbinding.
The gestational sequence in 22:5 made the focus read as a reversal of settled growth, timed emergence, maturation, and care.
The sky held from falling in 22:65 widened childbirth into a surah-level hold/release architecture.
The intoxication denial became an epistemic correction from visible symptom to hidden cause.
The barren day in 22:55 linked catastrophic time to interrupted futurity.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly returned to the focus's exact pressure points: womb and growth, holding and falling, face and heart, nourishment and forced tasting, and day as both elastic duration and barren event. Those recurrences supported several coexisting mechanisms without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The reversed developmental sequence may be a designed mechanism or a strong retrospective alignment of independent examples.
The forced-weaning and ecological-bearer readings are branch-backed resonances, but their intended prominence cannot be fixed from the packet alone.
The barren-day link may target reproductive futurity specifically or use barrenness more generally for a day without good outcome.
